custom_logic_notes: The 89-period Trend EMA acts as a directional filter - long entries are only taken when price is above the Trend EMA, and short entries only when price is below it. The EA closes opposite positions on signal reversal before potentially entering a new position. Crossover detection uses previous bar values ([1]) compared against current bar values ([0]) to confirm the crossover.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward EMA crossover strategy. Use pandas EWM for EMA calculation. Crossover detection: compare EMA values at index -1 vs -2 (previous bar crossover confirmation). Trend filter: check close price relative to 89-period EMA. SL/TP are fixed pip values - apply pip multiplier based on symbol digits. New bar detection: compare current bar time with stored last bar time. Position check: verify no open positions before entry. Close opposite on reversal signal.
